package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"slices"

	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/installation"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/artifact"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/record"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/runner"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/runner/internal/exploration"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/runner/internal/minimizer"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(3)
	}
}

func run() (retErr error) {
	var input struct {
		Operation, Installation, Artifact, Output string
		AttemptBudget                             uint64                          `json:"attempt_budget"`
		Config                                    exploration.SimulationConfig    `json:"config"`
		Original                                  exploration.SimulationCandidate `json:"original"`
		AcceptedIndices                           []uint64                        `json:"accepted_indices"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if input.Operation == "proposals" || input.Operation == "canonical" {
		if input.Config.ControllerSHA256 == "" {
			input.Config.ControllerSHA256 = exploration.SimulationImplementationSHA256()
		}
		for index, forced := range input.Original.Overrides {
			canonical, err := exploration.CanonicalForcedDecision(forced)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			input.Original.Overrides[index] = canonical
		}
		original, err := exploration.CanonicalCandidate(input.Config, input.Original.Overrides, "")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if input.Operation == "canonical" {
			return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"config": input.Config, "original": original})
		}
		state, err := minimizer.New(input.Config, original, input.AttemptBudget)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		proposals := []minimizer.Attempt{}
		for {
			attempt, ok, err := minimizer.Next(state)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if !ok {
				break
			}
			proposals = append(proposals, attempt)
			state, err = minimizer.Commit(state, attempt, slices.Contains(input.AcceptedIndices, attempt.Index))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{
			"config": input.Config, "original": original, "proposals": proposals,
			"accepted": state.Accepted, "attempts": state.Attempts, "stop_reason": state.StopReason,
		})
	}
	if input.Operation == "minimize" {
		description, err := installation.Resolve(installation.Spec{ExplicitManifest: input.Installation})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		provider, err := description.Provider()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result, err := runner.Minimize(context.Background(), runner.MinimizeSpec{
			Backend: provider, ArtifactPath: input.Artifact, OutputRoot: input.Output, AttemptBudget: input.AttemptBudget,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result)
	}
	if input.Operation != "changed-signature" {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", input.Operation)
	}
	opened, err := artifact.OpenArtifact(input.Artifact)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := opened.Close(); retErr == nil {
			retErr = err
		}
	}()
	manifest := opened.Manifest()
	var payloads []artifact.Payload
	for _, file := range manifest.Files {
		data, err := opened.ReadPayload(file.Path, uint64(file.Size))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if file.Path == manifest.Streams.Stdout.File {
			if len(data) == 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("signature fixture requires nonempty stdout")
			}
			data[0] ^= 1
			file.SHA256 = record.HashBytes(data)
			manifest.Streams.Stdout.FullSHA256 = file.SHA256
			manifest.Streams.Stdout.RetainedSHA256 = file.SHA256
		}
		payloads = append(payloads, artifact.Payload{Path: file.Path, Mode: 0600, Data: data, SHA256: file.SHA256, Size: file.Size})
	}
	published, err := (artifact.Store{Root: input.Output, Key: artifact.StoreKeyRecord}).PublishArtifact(artifact.Publication{Record: manifest, Payloads: payloads})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"artifact": published.Path, "failure_signature": published.Manifest.Outcome.FailureSignature})
}
